ContractVersion.description:
Contract revision: `major` breaks, `minor` adds. Before the first release
minor bumps may also break shape, as all components ship together.

description:
First message a core sends after connect: the reply to `GET /hello`,
and the first frame on the bus socket after the client's
[`Subscribe`](crate::Subscribe).

head.description:
The stream's latest offset when the hello was sent; 0 before any
event. On the bus socket, events after it follow (live or replayed
from `resume_from`). Same wire form as `CloudEvent.dekoffset`.

heartbeat_ms.description:
How often, in milliseconds, the core sends a heartbeat (a ping) on
the bus socket; a core advertises 1000 to 30000 (1-30 s). Clients
clamp the value to that range (0 or absent: their own default) and
drop a link silent for three intervals of the clamped value, so a
core pinging less often than every 30 s gets its links dropped.

storage.description:
The storage the core serves (contract 1.22): the same id across
restarts over the same storage, a new one for new or restored storage
(a backup read back is new storage). At most [`STORAGE_MAX_BYTES`]
bytes. Absent from an older core: dek then cannot tell fresh storage
from a restart.

stream.description:
The core's bus stream: with an offset, the position a client resumes
from (`Subscribe.stream`). New on every core start.

title: Hello
